TableShipGroupTask/other_bundle_rows ids 8-10 taskDesc: source says '无限制赛达到X分' (tabledata_v1.ab) vs '巅峰赛达到X分' (tabledata.ab) for the same taskTitle '天梯积分'. Translated 无限制赛 literally as 'Unrestricted Match' (as distinct from '巅峰赛'/'Peak Arena') since it's not in the established glossary; could also be a build-revision renaming of the same ranked mode.
TableShipGroupTaskGroup groupTitle '期间任务': translated as 'Event Missions' (limited-time/seasonal mission group); 'Period Missions' or 'Limited-Time Missions' are plausible alternates.
TableShipGroupTrialProp id 2 '魂玉': translated as 'Soul Orb' (distinct from 宝石/'Gem' and from 附魂/'Soul-Enchant' in the established glossary) since it doesn't appear in prior glossary entries.
TableShipGroupTrialProp id 12 '霸气' translated as 'Haki', the established official One Piece localization term for this power, not a generic 'Domineering/Dominance'.

TableShipGroupTrialBoss bossName '大熊' translated as 'Kuma' (Bartholomew Kuma), matching common One Piece localization naming style used for the other bosses (Ace, Garp, Enel, etc. rather than full titles).
